documents.text: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: Sizes per printer come from the plates wiki's general "Build Plate Dimensions" table (the Dual-Texture tab has none); stored as product.length/product.width per Printer Model option. They agree with the store page's "Usable Print Size" (256*256mm / 180*180mm).

Thickness: the store page row gives three layers ("Textured PEI - 0.075mm / Smooth PEI - 0.125mm / Stainless Steel Plate - 0.4mm"), while the description prose says "a 0.5mm magnetic stainless steel plate". The table row wins over prose; no curated thickness is written. The deterministic page row physical.thickness carries value_num 0.075 (the Textured PEI layer, the first number), unverified.

The store page's "Packaging Size" (300*270*17mm / 220*190*15mm) and "Packaging Weight" (0.45kg / 0.23kg) cells list two values with no option labels; they are not mapped to options (that would rest on row order only). No net weight is published.

The plates wiki's Important Notice on two 256×256 mm plate generations names the Textured PEI, Smooth PEI and Cool Plate SuperTack plates only, not the Dual-Texture plate; the store page's own option notes (P1 Series: older plate without type detection on 2nd Gen machines; X2D/P2S: disable Build Plate Position Detection) are kept in the printer relations' notes and as the page's variant.note rows.
Glue: per material and per surface only (store page Recommended Settings); no unconditional requires relation exists, so none is written.

Bed temperatures per filament on this plate have no registry key for a plate (print_settings.bed_temp applies to filament only); they are kept in the material relations' quotes and notes. The material-table wiki has no Dual-Texture column, so its Smooth/Textured PEI columns are not applied to this plate.
No in-the-box list: neither the store page nor the wiki gives an official packing list for this plate.
